summary: Comprehensive backend pytest suite (26 tests) and frontend smoke tests for Packr. Backend: 26/26 passing, all auth/wardrobe/trip/grid/favorite/occasion/checklist/extras/geocode/weather/isolation flows verified. Frontend: login -> onboarding -> dashboard verified on mobile viewport (390x844); all dashboard widgets render (trip card with weather, packing progress, stats, wardrobe summary, theme toggle, logout, add-trip). 5 tabs render and are tappable.

minor.issue: No explicit ownership check before update_one; relies on filter {'user_id': user_id} silently no-op for non-owners then 404 from re-fetch. Functionally correct (returns 404 to non-owners) but consider returning 404 explicitly when matched_count==0 for clarity.
JWT_SECRET in /app/backend/.env is 31 bytes (PyJWT InsecureKeyLengthWarning). Recommend >=32 byte secret.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping theme toggle changes the icon (moon<->sun) but the visible color palette barely changes — background remains near-black in both modes. Need to verify ThemeProvider actually re-applies light tokens to surfaces.

integration_issues.flow: Auth gate routing for already-onboarded users
integration_issues.issue: Seeded test@packr.app user (which already has 1 trip and 3 wardrobe items in DB) is routed to /onboarding/explainer on login instead of straight to /(tabs). The seed user document likely lacks an 'onboarded:true' flag, or the frontend store is not treating presence-of-trips as onboarded. Tapping Get Started successfully advances to dashboard, so functional but adds an extra step for returning users.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo log shows: 'ExpoFontLoader.loadAsync rejected. Font file for ionicons is empty.' UI still renders fallbacks (icons appear), but font loader is throwing on startup. Recommend ensuring @expo/vector-icons is correctly bundled or pre-loading the font in _layout.tsx with Font.loadAsync.

action_items: Investigate why test@packr.app routes through onboarding/explainer despite having existing trips. Check store.ts hydration logic and whether seeded user has onboarded flag in DB.
Verify ThemeProvider light-mode actually re-paints surfaces (background, cards). Currently visual delta between dark/light is minimal except for the toggle icon.
Lengthen JWT_SECRET to >=32 bytes to silence PyJWT InsecureKeyLengthWarning.
critical_code_review_comments: Trip update endpoints (grid/favorite/occasion/checklist/extras) silently no-op for non-owners then re-fetch trip and return 404. Consider checking update_one().matched_count and 404 explicitly for cleaner semantics.
/api/weather endpoint accepts start_date/end_date query params but never uses them — they should either be wired through to Open-Meteo or removed.

DELETE /api/wardrobe/{item_id} runs trips.update_many with positional `$` — works only for first occurrence in grid. If the same wardrobe id were placed in multiple slots this would only null the first match. Low risk in practice (UI prevents) but worth a comment or arrayFilters.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (login + onboarding + dashboard + theme toggle interaction + tab nav verified; deeper Studio/Grid/Lookbook/Checklist e2e flows not exhaustively automated)

seed_data_creation: Tests register temporary TEST_*-prefixed users/items/trips and clean them up via teardown fixtures. No seed data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_packr_backend.py covers all 13 backend feature bullets with 26 passing tests. Reuse for regression. Test user test@packr.app/test1234. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the canonical base URL. Frontend testIDs confirmed: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, login-go-register-button, onboarding-start-button, theme-toggle-button, logout-button, add-trip-button, trip-card-{id}, quick-go-grid-button, tab-{home|studio|grid|lookbook|pack}.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking bug. Two minor concerns documented (returning-user routing through onboarding, light theme appears unchanged).
